exposure: pregnancy care provision by an obstetrician-gynaecologist
whether the childbirth experience fit the father's expectations
outcome: first-time fathers' experiences attending labour and birth
cohort: This study recruited 200 first-time fathers in Tehran, Iran.
finding: First-time fathers' overall experiences were significantly affected by their partner's education, insurance coverage, pregnancy care provision, preparedness for childbirth, and whether the experience met their expectations.
cross-section timing: around the time of labour and birth
